limitations: Consistent identical primary signatures cannot exclude physically distinct molecules sharing the same full name
Names are scoped to this source and technical group, not asserted globally unique
Secondary and supplementary payloads are not subjected to primary-end collision checks
Technical grouping supplies no biological lane, library or platform-unit metadata
template_identity_audit.memory_scope: Bounded template-entry dictionary with compact digests; external process-tree RSS admission remains required
template_identity_audit.primary_signature_fields: Full FLAG, reference/start/end, MAPQ, mate reference/start, TLEN, CIGAR, sequence and qualities; optional tags excluded
template_identity_audit.receipt_scope: Every admitted alignment offered by the caller from its declared bounded region, before downsampling; reconcile this count with caller traversal/exclusion counts; missing mates may be outside scope but that is not inferred
template_identity_audit.template_key: exact full unmodified seven-field Illumina QNAME within pinned source and technical group

preflight.scope: metadata compatibility only; full extraction must revalidate every record

identities.remote_bam_identity_scope: official URL/size/Last-Modified plus received byte-range hashes; full BAM not acquired
